text: ゆうれい　や　むし　くらい　だぜ！

structure.jp: ゆうれい　や　むし

patterns.name: 〜くらい
patterns.span: むし　くらい　だ
patterns.explanation: くらいだ after a short list says 'that is about all there is'. ゆうれい　や　むし　くらい　だ = 'only ghosts and bugs, that's about it'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, manly talk that pushes the statement at the listener. くらい　だぜ = 'that's about it, I tell you'.
